card.text: Giant planet 71 au from HR 8799, one of the first exoplanets ever photographed.

sources.label: Marois et al. 2008
sources.quote: High-contrast observations with the Keck and Gemini telescopes have revealed three planets orbiting the star HR 8799

introduction.text: HR 8799 b is a young gas giant of about 5.8 Jupiter masses, 71 au from its star. One orbit takes about 496 years, near a 2:1 resonance with its neighbours.

sources.label: Marois et al. 2008

sources.quote: periods very close to the 2:1 resonance

color.title: JWST infrared colour
color.summary: Its 4.1 to 4.6 µm brightness from JWST as blue, green and red, on one scale with its siblings. One colour, not a map.
